subject.title: feat(fleet): harden create, port allocation, drift visibility, and operator docs

question: Should Fleet permanently retain an unhealthy newly created cell and treat non-EADDRINUSE loopback-probe failures as advisory before the container runtime's authoritative bind?
rationale: These choices define operator cleanup expectations and the host/container-runtime security boundary; source and tests can verify mechanics but cannot select the permanent product policy.

options.title: Accept documented semantics
options.body: Keep retained unhealthy cells and advisory non-EADDRINUSE probes after live backend proof and explicit owner acceptance.

options.title: Restore stricter failure behavior
options.body: Clean up failed creates and fail closed on probe errors, accepting reduced diagnostics and less flexibility with rootful daemons.

recommendation.title: Accept documented semantics
recommendation.body: Keep retained unhealthy cells and advisory non-EADDRINUSE probes after live backend proof and explicit owner acceptance.
